newsitem.title: MEXICO: Condumex to exit Mexican Bolsa.
newsitem.headline: Condumex to exit Mexican Bolsa.

text.p: Grupo Condumex SA, a unit of conglomerate Grupo Carso, said it will no longer trade its shares on the Mexican Stock Exchange (Bolsa) beginning on Tuesday.

Shareholders at Condumex, a copper wire maker, voted to stop trade during a shareholder meeting in December, the company said in a statement to the Bolsa. It received approval from Mexican authorities to stop trade on February 13.
During late 1996, Carso bought the remaining outstanding shares of Condumex to push its ownership of the company to 100 percent.
